title: The MATCH function: the position of a value
summary: MATCH returns the position number of a value inside a range, not the value itself.
intro: `MATCH` answers the question "in which position?": it returns the number of the cell that holds the value inside the range. Use 0 as the third argument for an exact match.
args: A single row or a single column.
0 for an exact match, 1 (the default) for the largest value that does not exceed it in a sorted list.
examples: "Ruler" is the third item in the range.
errors: The value is not in the range.

faq.q: Does MATCH return the row number on the sheet?
faq.a: No, it returns the position inside the range: the first cell of the range is number 1.
